title: Everyday Pay Card Cashback Rate Card — Cartwise Shopper Payouts
content:
Rate card of the Everyday Pay Card cashback programme within Cartwise Shopper Payouts. Rates are percentages of the card purchase amount; amounts are US dollars per statement month.

## Rates and monthly figures

| Plan | Fuel stations | EV charging networks | Auto repair and maintenance merchants | Monthly cashback cap (USD) | Payment day of the following month | Smallest payment (USD) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Weekly Direct Deposit | 0% | 0% | 0% | 0.00 | 0 (no cashback paid) | 0.00 |
| Instant Cashout | 0% | 0% | 0% | 0.00 | 0 (no cashback paid) | 0.00 |
| Everyday Pay Card Blue | 2% | 2% | 1% | 25.00 | 5 | 1.00 |
| Everyday Pay Card Gold | 3% | 3% | 1% | 40.00 | 5 | 1.00 |
| Everyday Pay Card Platinum | 4% | 4% | 2% | 60.00 | 5 | 1.00 |
| Everyday Pay Card Diamond | 5% | 5% | 2% | 100.00 | 5 | 1.00 |

## Programme settings

| Setting | Weekly Direct Deposit | Instant Cashout | Everyday Pay Card Blue, Gold, Platinum and Diamond |
|---|---|---|---|
| Purchases counted toward a statement month | Settled purchases | Settled purchases | Settled purchases |
| Cashback reduced when a qualifying purchase is refunded | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Only purchases paid with the Everyday Pay Card count | No | No | Yes |
| Unpaid cashback lapses when the account closes | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Order in which categories fill the monthly cap | Fuel, then EV charging, then auto maintenance | Fuel, then EV charging, then auto maintenance | Fuel, then EV charging, then auto maintenance |

## Notes

- Cashback of a statement month below the smallest payment carries to the next month.
- The payment day is a day of the month following the statement month; on the card plans it is the 5th.
- The cap order means the monthly cap is taken up first by fuel cashback, then by EV charging cashback, then by auto repair and maintenance cashback.

*Hypothetical month on Everyday Pay Card Blue:* settled card purchases of 600.00 at fuel stations, 200.00 at EV charging networks and 300.00 at auto repair merchants give 12.00, 4.00 and 3.00, a total of 19.00, which is within the 25.00 cap and at least the 1.00 smallest payment. On Everyday Pay Card Gold the same purchases give 18.00, 6.00 and 3.00, a total of 27.00, within that plan's 40.00 cap.
